bio: Relax and unwind in peaceful surroundings at De Vere Latimer Estate. Indulge in a delicious Afternoon Tea while enjoying the wonderful romantic ambience provided by this stunning venue.  The stylish interior of this venue is characterised by ornate furnishings which create a suitably elegant environment of enjoy the British tradition of Afternoon Tea.  Their Afternoon Tea features a delightful range of treats with an added savoury element for diners to enjoy.  De Vere Latimer Estate is located in in the heart of Buckinghamshire, just a 5-minute drive from Chalfont & Latimer train station.
